Important: This is a pre-owned product and is not in brand-new cosmetic condition. Scratches, scuffs and other reasonable signs of previous use may be present and will vary between individual units. Product images are for model reference only. Cosmetic imperfections do not affect the intended functionality of the product.

Grade A – Approx. 90% New
Excellent overall condition. May have minor scratches, marks or light signs of previous use.

Grade B – Approx. 80% New
Good functional condition with more visible scratches, scuffs or signs of previous use.

Every Pre-Owned HITWAY is inspected for:

Motor operation

Battery and charging

Display and controls

Braking system

Lights and electrical functions

Tyres and wheels

Basic riding functionality

Powerful 250W Motor with 70Nm Torque for Confident Riding

The HITWAY BK9S electric bike is equipped with a 250W high-speed brushless hub motor that delivers up to 70Nm of torque, offering strong and reliable performance on city roads, mountain trails, and steep inclines up to 25°. Whether you're commuting or exploring off-road, it ensures smooth acceleration and excellent climbing power.

High-Capacity 720Wh Battery with Extended Range

Enjoy longer rides with the removable 48V 15Ah (720Wh) SAMSUNG lithium-ion battery, which provides a remarkable range of 70–150 km (43–93 miles) on a single charge, depending on terrain, riding mode, and conditions. The battery is securely integrated and comes with a locking mechanism for added theft protection, while charging takes only 6–7 hours.

26×4.0 Inch Fat Tyres & Dual Suspension for All-Terrain Comfort

Designed with oversized 26×4.0-inch pneumatic tyres, a front suspension fork, and a shock-absorbing saddle, the BK9S is built to handle any surface—including snow, sand, gravel, and asphalt. These features work together to absorb bumps and ensure a stable, smooth ride on any adventure.

Seamless Control with Shimano 7-Speed & LCD Display

Customize your ride with two riding modes (pedal and pedal-assist) and three PAS levels. The Shimano 7-speed drivetrain lets you easily adapt to varying terrain, while the upgraded LCD display keeps you informed with real-time data including speed, distance, battery level, and gear selection. Integrated front light and reflectors enhance visibility for safe night riding.

Designed for Your Journey – Reliable, Comfortable, and User-Focused

From commuting to leisure riding, the HITWAY BK9S is built for riders who demand more: more range, more power, and more comfort. With a solid 33.4 kg aluminum alloy frame, a user-friendly setup, and a package that includes all necessary tools and instructions, it’s ready to go wherever you go. Whether you’re tackling your daily route or exploring the unknown, the BK9S empowers you to ride with confidence. And with our dedicated support and 2-year warranty, help is always within reach.
